authorInfo.bio: John Bunyan was an English writer and nonconformist preacher. He is best remembered as the author of the Christian allegory The Pilgrim's Progress, which also became an influential literary model. In addition to The Pilgrim's Progress, Bunyan wrote nearly sixty titles, many of them expanded sermons.

description: "The Heavenly Footman; Or, A Description of the Man That Gets to Heaven" by John Bunyan is a theological work written in the late 17th century, during a period of religious awakening and reform. This book falls under the category of a spiritual manual, focusing on the Christian journey toward salvation and eternal life.
